credibility.summary: Management demonstrates high credibility by meeting specific commissioning timelines for complex projects, which is immediately reflected in the significant revenue and margin expansion in H1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue growth aligns with narrative: The jump from INR 2,120Cr (Mar 26) to INR 3,076Cr (Sep 26) validates the commissioning of new projects.
Margin expansion matches guidance: Management's focus on high-value intermediates is reflected in OPM rising from 13% (FY26) to 20-21% in H1 FY27.
Phenolics dominance: Narrative of growth is heavily supported by Phenolics, which contributed INR 2,291 crore of the INR 3,091 crore Q2 FY27 revenue.

calls.tone: Confident and optimistic, supported by record performance and strategic asset commissioning.
